verdict.rationale: The docs mention platform-specific install behavior on Linux and Windows (hardlinks), and a community report describes isolated installs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, so `bun install` runs on all three. However, nothing explicitly states that the same workflow and config behave identically across operating systems. Another user reports install crashes when switching between WSL and Windows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OS-neutral config and workflow parity, stable Windows/WSL behavior without crashes, and an official supported-platforms statement.
